title: Fuel Our Shared Future:
title_short: Comcast CTV :30 · HD file in review
headline: A young woman says everything she wants to be is inside her and it takes support to bring it out. Your support gives young people a real shot. Scan the code.
story: A 30-second streaming TV spot for NFTE and BUILD. It opens and closes on the QR screen, so anyone watching with a phone can scan at once. Naije’e, the young lady in pink, opens the spot and closes it: the full circle Denise asked for.

In between there is no other sound bite: the narrator carries it over pictures. BUILD students pitching under <q>a real shot at building their future by bringing ideas to life</q>, and Darius, the alum, under <q>because someone like you invested in a future like theirs</q>. Then the QR screen comes back large, Naije’e says <q>Fuel a future like mine</q>, and the spot expands to the final screen.

Loop: What brings out what is inside her? opens at 0:00, closes on someone like you. Denise asked in writing for the combined NFTE | BUILD logo on the QR screen, and that screen opens the spot: it is the one logo before the final screen. This item is the 16:9 HD file of the spot, in review since 29 Oct. The plan is the same as on the Needs Revisions item for this spot.

Exactly 30.0 s. Not one frame more.

Comcast's ad content rules ask spots like this one for a sponsor ID line on screen. Denise's notes do not mention it. Nick confirms with Denise if it goes on the final screen.
